name: B_wideleaf_divaddr
desc: 45_dual_gemm grid-strided WIDE-leaf divide: the corrected magic-rcp quotient feeds an IMAD.WIDE.U32 address (coord0*stride+base). The chain walk descends PAST the true IMAD.HI quotient leaf into that non-zero-addend/live-LO address WIDE and skipped it (addend_zero=False lo_dead=False reg_dividend=True) => divide UNrecognized => off-by-one quotient => wrong/duplicate write addresses. IntDivRecognize must stop at the IMAD.HI quotient leaf (do not hop the +1 quotient-correction PHI).
